race.description: Community Bank Fleurieu - Bendigo Bank Plate (C1)
race.comment: SUIT OF WANDS (5) doesn't win out of turn but is knocking on the door. Strips rock-hard fit deep into this campaign and is 1/1 over this track and trip. Should stalk the early speed and be poised to pounce when they quicken. VALUED (6) never looked likely last start when he was too bad to be true but his form prior was rock-solid and would stack right up for a race of this calibre. Worth forgiving. EMPIRESTATEOFMIND (2) exceeded expectations last start when chasing gamely into second over a similar trip at Murray Bridge. Should be nearing his peak now and is right in the mix. TERMINAL SHOCK (13) chased gamely into the placings fresh, then put it all together second-up when shedding her maiden tag. Has more to offer third-up and is drawn kindly. HEAT OF THE NIGHT (11) will likely settle a long way back again but if they overcook it early she could cause a scare late.
